# Monaco Editor vendor files

- Version: `0.56.0`
- Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/monaco-editor/v/0.56.0>
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` and `ThirdPartyNotices.txt` in this directory.
- Runtime: prebuilt `min/` assets are served by Django staticfiles. No Node.js build step is required.

When upgrading, replace the complete `min/` directory together with the license files so editor workers and hashed chunks stay in sync.
